europe_now.title: Google Fined €403 Million Over Location Data
europe_now.summary: Google has been hit with a €403 million fine by Irish regulators regarding the handling and tracking of user location data. The penalty addresses issues related to invasive privacy practices and compliance with data regulations.

europe_now.title: German Regional Election Setbacks for Chancellor Merz
europe_now.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faces significant political pressure following regional election setbacks and gains by opposition parties. Merz has vowed to maintain the ruling coalition to preserve political stability.
